## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND show equity strength while sector breadth is mixed, supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Lower volatility/declining fear: VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) BELOW TREND indicating eased near-term fear. Credit and stocks vs bonds are effectively neutral (HYG (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND) — no clear funding stress signal.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: UUP (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY, indicating a softer dollar trend, while TLT (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND keeps duration demand present.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing catch-up: XLF (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +2.42%) ABOVE TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum showing relative strength given XLK and QQQ strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally outperforming: SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND versus China weakness FXI (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.44%) BELOW TREND; EM: EEM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND shows selective EM participation.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk active: IBIT (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +25.81%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +7.52% | 1M: +32.51%) ABOVE TREND; thematic/speculative ARKK (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +23.80%) ABOVE TREND confirms broad risk-on pockets.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals and base metals strong: GLD (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND — reflationary tilt in pockets.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed/rolling over: XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) CORRECTION while nat gas UNG (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND — watch divergences within the complex.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND confirm equity leadership; Major divergence present (multiple CORRECTION signals across XLE, MTUM, XLY) indicating a transitional internals picture that supports the NEUTRAL read.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective growth/momentum: XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, reduce exposure to laggards such as XLU (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION; bonds (TLT (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND) remain an effective hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND; Crypto/blockchain IBIT (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +25.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION; Utilities XLU (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Brent BNO (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) CORRECTION if downside momentum continues.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX 20 for complacency (VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) BELOW TREND), HYG/LQD spread around 0.80 for credit health (HYG (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND), and XLK/ XLF relative pivot around 2.0 as a growth vs value leadership signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, equities (SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND; QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND) showing pockets of strength while internals are mixed. Key risk: major divergence across multiple CORRECTION signals (XLE, MTUM, XLY) — monitor rotation and commodity/energy fades.
